method: Research profiles + connected locality cores; province-overlap population redistribution.

ZAQ.name: Hunza
ZAQ.confidence: Tunja highland seat secure; compact northern core inferred.

TAY.name: Tairona
TAY.confidence: Sierra Nevada settlement network well attested; single playable government and shared Chibchan culture are abstractions.

TPAC.name: Tupinambá
TPAC.confidence: Bahian coastal core supported; later colonial ethnonyms projected cautiously into 1444.

POTC.name: Potiguara
POTC.confidence: Paraíba and Rio Grande do Norte coastal presence supported by early contact accounts; not a modern reservation boundary.

TPQC.name: Tupiniquim
TPQC.confidence: Espírito Santo coast represented inside vanilla's larger Rio de Janeiro region.

NDVC.name: Guarani
NDVC.confidence: Upper Paraná/eastern Paraguay settlement core; one playable tag abstracts multiple communities.

KHG.name: Kaingang
KHG.confidence: Southern Jê uplands represented by a Tibagi plateau core; later Kaingang political unity is not assumed.

CUAC.name: Charrúa
CUAC.confidence: Lower Uruguay/eastern bank core inferred; avoids a Buenos Aires capital and continent-wide claims.

MPCC.name: Mapuche
MPCC.confidence: South-central Chilean core; excludes later Mapuche expansion east into the Pampas. The existing patagonian culture is retained as the mod's shared proxy.

QIM.name: Quilmes
QIM.confidence: Calchaquí valley settlement core; aimara is the pre-existing mod proxy, not a claim that the Diaguita were Aymara.
